method: Read-only OOXML structural extraction, embedded-picture visual review, and reconstructed preview of LifeLogging Part 1 B97:H136. November 11 correction applies the author's operative pattern architecture and checks G3 pp. 25-26, Matrix Studio documentation/code and related local website source. No spreadsheet edits or recalculation.

architecture_clarification.authority: Direct author clarification; supersedes the earlier optional-address/passive-mapping interpretation of the core architecture, not every unresolved spreadsheet relationship.
architecture_clarification.core: Seven nested horn tori with programmable facets organise patterns. Select and stack patterns, compute with AI to generate documents, websites and other chosen outputs, inspect and correct, regroup and repeat across multiple selves.

geometry.binding: Records retain stable identity while their facet, group, stack and other spatial relationships can change. Selected patterns and ordered stacks are operative organisation for computation, not merely optional display tags.
geometry.layer_semantics: No new fixed meanings or names are assigned to the seven shells. Source philosophical associations remain attributed and editable.

distinct_axes.geometry: Seven nested horn tori, sides, facets and additional addresses or stack layers.
distinct_axes.observer_streams: Environment, character attention and narrator; participant meaning is a separate attributed account.
distinct_axes.self_lenses: Past, present and conditional best selves; not assigned one-to-one to shells or observers.
distinct_axes.access_contexts: Public, private and secret contextual selves; not interchangeable with the three observer identities.

access_architecture.internal: Private and secret material with differentiated encryption and permissions.
access_architecture.external: A selected public projection with reduced information and capabilities. Permission to read does not automatically grant computation, training, editing, execution, republication, external action or access to restricted source material. Each further operation needs its own applicable grant.
access_architecture.derived_material: Outputs, summaries, embeddings and other derivatives retain relevant source restrictions unless an explicit disclosure decision permits release.
access_architecture.movement: Changing a spatial address, stack or surface must not silently expand authority.
unresolved_implementation: enforcement across devices and compute services

implementation_boundary.matrix_studio_code_inspected: Address validation, table-to-facet or stack allocation, local Visit/Recall/Pause sequences, compact stack spans and aura-agent-program/1 packaging.
implementation_boundary.intended_next_connection: Connect selected pattern inputs and instructions to a permitted AI compute service, return source-linked outputs and apply reviewed corrections to versioned records and groupings.
not_established: A connected production AI pattern-compute service in the static studio
An encrypted personal vault or enforced private/secret/public grants in browser storage
Personal model training from questionnaire completion
Automatic integration between this questionnaire and Matrix Studio
implementation_boundary.verification: Documentation and selected code paths read; Matrix Studio browser and test suite were not run during this correction. Public URL fetches failed; related website observations use local checked-out HTML.

regions.title: Seven coloured address grids
regions.source_observation: Explicit 12 by 24 grids and labels for questions, faces and first-column identity themes.
regions.proposed_use: Use the seven-shell facet architecture to organise and select patterns and compose ordered stacks for AI computation, generated outputs and iterative correction/regrouping. Preserve independent record identity and one-to-many bindings.
regions.ambiguity: The operative architecture is author-clarified on 2026-11-11. The meaning of each particular source allocation remains attributed; every address need not be filled for MVS.

regions.title: Four later template banks
regions.source_observation: Seven-colour grids repeat with differing collections underneath.
regions.proposed_use: Record bank identity as well as colour/facet when interpreting source.
regions.ambiguity: Alternative versions, stages or simultaneous banks are not specified.

regions.title: Alternate reading direction
regions.source_observation: Instruction explicitly calls for switching reading direction for alternate meaning.
regions.proposed_use: Preserve reading direction, grouping and relationship labels in import records.
regions.ambiguity: Exact reversal rules and intended alternate meanings are not specified.

regions.title: Traits on vectors or facets
regions.source_observation: Author asks whether character traits should be embedded in vector colour groups instead of facet matrices.
regions.proposed_use: Keep facet/vector allocation editable and record alternatives.
regions.ambiguity: Do not silently resolve this design choice.

regions.title: Words and grammar
regions.source_observation: Common-word and grammar labels accompany several separate vertical word lists.
regions.proposed_use: Use participant definitions, examples, synonyms and contrasting interpretations as optional semantic prompts.
regions.ambiguity: Same-row words are not paired semantic records; corpus size/frequency claims were not independently validated.

regions.title: Traits and semantic lenses
regions.source_observation: Character themes and a colour/trait/definition/context/example collection coexist.
regions.proposed_use: Ask for concrete episodes, counterexamples, personal meanings, ideals and review indicators.
regions.ambiguity: A row-wise join between inventories is unsupported.

regions.title: Practical life themes
regions.source_observation: Home, food, clothing, communication, learning, work, gifts, transport, travel and other themes; home subtopics start separately.
regions.proposed_use: Branch from domain to concrete objects, actions, preferences and constraints.
regions.ambiguity: Depth and completeness vary by domain.

regions.title: Relationship chapters
regions.source_observation: Love, courting, receiving, exit, exploring, negotiation, family and later-life themes.
regions.proposed_use: Capture desired reciprocity, boundaries, changes over time and responsible exits.
regions.ambiguity: Do not infer the participant has followed a prescribed relationship sequence.

regions.title: Emotions, goals and social areas
regions.source_observation: Emotions, learning/travel/creative goals and family/courting/friends occupy separate regions.
regions.proposed_use: Link goals and emotional self-report through explicit records.
regions.ambiguity: Neighbouring repeated word lists are not completed questionnaire answers.

regions.title: Clock framework
regions.source_observation: Labels span immense to tiny scales; a toroidal clock reference appears nearby.
regions.proposed_use: Capture event time, duration, temporal horizon and approximation separately.
regions.ambiguity: List includes mixed or imprecise scientific labels; not a validated conversion table.

regions.title: Activation and review
regions.source_observation: First/recent activation, count, timeline, calendar, renewal, downtime, thresholds, reminders, synchronisation and backup.
regions.proposed_use: Version observations and log activations, reviews and exports.
regions.ambiguity: No scheduler implementation is specified.

regions.title: Focal points and interface
regions.source_observation: Interface controls, permissions, urgency, importance and personal concepts begin a larger focus collection.
regions.proposed_use: Keep attention controls, permissions and user priorities separate.
regions.ambiguity: The selected range is the beginning of a larger collection, not the complete list.

regions.title: Abstract construction and action words
regions.source_observation: Binary/Boolean/shape concepts sit apart from interrogatives and action verbs.
regions.proposed_use: Represent compositional relationships explicitly and offer multiple query routes.
regions.ambiguity: Proximity does not establish an executable grammar.

regions.title: Character code reference
regions.source_observation: Header labels a character-code collection; CHAR formulas appear in the table.
regions.proposed_use: Treat as a technical reference with its own schema.
regions.ambiguity: The source wording 256 Bit ASCii Code is not an endorsed technical definition.

regions.title: Startup ideas and self practice
regions.source_observation: Project ideas sit separately from self/practice themes.
regions.proposed_use: Use project ambition as a goal collection linked to skills, resources and outcomes.
regions.ambiguity: These ranges show beginnings of larger inventories; no causal relation to character-code rows is established.

regions.title: Governance and information flow
regions.source_observation: Privacy, independence, interdependence, governance and best practices.
regions.proposed_use: Capture intended audience, use permissions, review and autonomy boundaries.
regions.ambiguity: A recorded permission intention does not enforce access control.

regions.title: Action development, priority and allocation
regions.source_observation: Specific action contexts plus importance/urgency/value/rewards and resources/constraints.
regions.proposed_use: Separate action context, priority dimensions, expected value and constraints.
regions.ambiguity: No single scoring formula is provided.

regions.title: December 2026 age anchor
regions.source_observation: My Age at December 3rd; age 44 appears above 2026.
regions.proposed_use: Frame simulations after the December birthday at age 44.
regions.ambiguity: This establishes an age/date relationship, not future events or future responses.

regions.title: Process reordering modes
regions.source_observation: Casual, Part Time, Full Time and Immersion transitions to Busy and Hyper Busy.
regions.proposed_use: Adapt capture granularity and session order to available attention; label new scheduling assumptions.
regions.ambiguity: No numerical ratio, required daily duration or cognitive acceleration rate is supplied. F and J columns hold independent lists.

regions.title: Memory and action selection
regions.source_observation: Memory, perception, action selection, action, arousal, thresholds, motives, expectation comparison and demand sensors.
regions.proposed_use: Collect trigger, options, motive, expectation, action and observed outcome.
regions.ambiguity: Borders do not fully define edge direction or executable behaviour.

regions.title: World models, mental stage and motives
regions.source_observation: Long-term memory, world models, mental stage, perception/action selection/action and separate value/emotion/interest bands.
regions.proposed_use: Keep experience, world interpretation, motives and action records distinct but linked.
regions.ambiguity: No validated cognitive measurement method is supplied.

regions.title: Options, self model and expectation
regions.source_observation: Options, self model, declarative/procedural memory, frame, plans, expectation and motive selection.
regions.proposed_use: Compare candidate actions and expected outcomes; capture demonstrable procedural knowledge.
regions.ambiguity: A hierarchy or a complete computational dependency graph is not specified.

regions.title: Motivators and modulators
regions.source_observation: Weight/gain/loss/baseline/volatility/range/duration and valence/arousal/understanding/focus/detail/attention.
regions.proposed_use: Offer optional contextual self-report and participant-defined weights with units and meanings.
regions.ambiguity: Do not convert to a normative personality score.

regions.title: Observation questions action and participation
regions.source_observation: Action circuit explicitly loops observation/questions/actions; doing, sharing and creating are explored through who/what/where/when/reasons.
regions.proposed_use: Repeat evidence-to-action-to-review cycles at personal, interpersonal, project and community scale.
regions.ambiguity: Technical claims about biological memory or other mechanisms remain source proposals.

regions.title: Situation and activity planning
regions.source_observation: Place/time/context queries and a bodyboarding/surfing planning example.
regions.proposed_use: Capture opportunities with relevant context, current information, dependencies and decision boundaries.
regions.ambiguity: Does not supply current forecast or travel data.

regions.title: Repeatable reflection and list making
regions.source_observation: Relationship exercises and a broad list-making collection.
regions.proposed_use: Use original prompts or retain attribution when deliberately reusing a sourced exercise.
regions.ambiguity: Borrowed-looking exercises and embedded images need attribution before republication.

regions.title: Narrative and evidence of change
regions.source_observation: Narrative themes beside cause/effect/state/delay/reasons/evidence/point-of-view headings.
regions.proposed_use: Capture narrative episodes with evidence, uncertainty, delay and perspective.
regions.ambiguity: Horizontal evidence fields are not nine answers for the neighbouring Motivations row.

regions.title: Time scales for a torus
regions.source_observation: Apply time to horn torus heading and time-measure collection.
regions.proposed_use: Allow multiple temporal horizons and approximate dates.
regions.ambiguity: Scientific reference content was not independently validated.

regions.title: Thought and communication modes
regions.source_observation: Casual/Normal/Urgent/Hyper, REM/brainwave labels, thought/typing/reading/speaking/urge candidates.
regions.proposed_use: Use actual session duration and self-report; retain candidate source parameters only as labelled ideas.
regions.ambiguity: Values are not validated human performance norms or participant measurements.

regions.title: Context, life-stage repetition and capabilities
regions.source_observation: Personal context, life-stage activity lists, degree titles and technical capability ideas occupy separate columns.
regions.proposed_use: Capture context and chosen life chapters without enforcing a universal sequence.
regions.ambiguity: Parenthood heading above column L does not fully explain its technical contents; row-wise joins are unsupported.

regions.title: Schooling allocation candidates
regions.source_observation: Week/day/class/modal percentages and time candidates.
regions.proposed_use: Use as inspiration for allocating modes in learning design, with all new allocations checked independently.
regions.ambiguity: T2:X2 totals 135; simultaneity versus exclusive categories is unspecified. No formulas are stored.

regions.title: Time and physiological rate candidates
regions.source_observation: Conversion-like numbers, heartbeats and breaths.
regions.proposed_use: Separate units and recorded measurements from illustrative constants.
regions.ambiguity: Not recalculated or clinically validated; no personal rates are inferred.

regions.title: Torus resolution candidates
regions.source_observation: Basic 288-facet, intermediate 1080-facet and scaled/expert capacity labels.
regions.proposed_use: Preserve source resolution candidates while using an explicit versioned address model in implementation.
regions.ambiguity: Does not override Matrix Studio fixed 12 by 24 current geometry.

matrix_studio_reference.caveat: Working spatial record and local program-composition prototype within a larger operative architecture. The intended AI compute/correct/regroup loop and private/secret/public encryption policy are not reduced to optional annotation because parts remain unimplemented. A connected AI service, secure vault, model training and Genesis conversations are not established by completing its forms.
